user.title: Govee LAN Control
user.description: Add a Govee lamp. LAN Control must be enabled for the device in the Govee Home app (device settings).

discover.title: Discovered Govee devices
discover.description: Select the device to add. Run the flow again to add more lamps.

manual.title: Add Govee device by IP
manual.description: Enter the lamp's IP address. Make sure LAN Control is enabled in the Govee Home app and the lamp is on the same network as Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: The device did not respond. Check the IP address, make sure LAN Control is enabled in the Govee Home app, and that UDP ports 4001-4003 are not blocked.

abort.already_configured: This device is already configured. Its IP address has been updated.
abort.no_devices_found: No new Govee devices found. Make sure LAN Control is enabled and the lamps are on the same network, or add the device by IP address.
abort.port_in_use: UDP port 4002 is in use by another integration (for example the built-in Govee lights local integration). Remove it or its devices first.
